column3: “Sacrifices” is plural instead of a single sacrifice; “spiritual” renders reasonable.
“World” renders “age”; “your” before “mind” matches the Textus Receptus (ὑμῶν).
“Each of us has one body” specifies the possessors of the body.
“Let him use it” supplies an instruction; “his” is added before faith.
Instructions to serve and teach supply verbs not expressed in the wording.
The brief phrases are expanded into explicit instructions.
